summary: World Omni Auto Receivables LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for World Omni Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C, a $1,011,080,000 auto-loan ABS offering. Classes A-1 through C price at 100.00000% to 99.98751%, coupons 3.908% to 4.95%, with a $75,000,000 SOFR plus 0.31% floater; monthly payments begin September 15, 2026. Credit enhancement includes a $2,527,719.95 reserve, overcollateralization, yield supplement overcollateralization and subordination. This is a routine term securitization, not a special situation; watch spread clearing and collateral performance.
